Hi team,

QBR scrub window is next week and I want to lock down owners and deadlines for the leadership review pack. Goal: produce an "exec-ready" pipeline deck by June 1 so Finance has one week to ingest and flag any sizing/recognition issues.

Quick asks:
- Can each manager confirm commit statuses for deals > $100k by EOD Tue (5/25)?
- Marissa — can you own consolidating the individual commit slides into the master deck?
- Vivek — please review the top 6 deals for risk/comments and flag any that need escalation.
- Laura — we need the executive summary slide + 1-paragraph signals for any pull-in/close risks.

I attached the template (Q2_pipeline_pack_template.xlsx) and a short slide notes doc to standardize language. Please drop links to any deal-specific playbooks in the shared Drive folder.

If anyone needs more time on commit confirmations, call it out now so we can reassign.

Thanks — Camila

Attachment: exec_summary_slide_notes.docx (docx, 45KB)

Thanks — pulling this together now. A couple of operational clarifications:

- Template usage: please fill only the "manager notes" and "commit details" tabs; I'll standardize the executive summary language.
- For deals > $250k I need: current forecast, historical run-rate, billing cadence, and any P0 open items (legal/security/procurement).
- Timeline: consolidated master to me by Wed 5/26 EOD; I will produce the final exec slide deck on Thu 5/27 and circulate to leadership for comment by Fri morning.

Marissa — I'll expect the manager slides in the Drive folder.
Vivek — please add your risk slide (unmapped risks) to the same folder.

Alex — looping you in for visibility on Horizon's timeline; if procurement expects delays, please reply with the expected PO date so we can set the commit status correctly.

If anyone needs exceptions to the timeline (sales on leave, customer meetings), flag here.

Laura
